family: Study-specific modified IEEE 33-bus based on Baran-Wu

prior_plan.simbench_status: Alternative exploratory work only; not the main research testbed. Prior outputs are retained, not erased.

provenance.topology_and_series_impedance_and_backgr: MATPOWER case33bw / Baran-Wu (1989), accessed through pinned pandapower conversion. Unit-length branch representation is not a physical 1 km line survey.
provenance.voltage_bounds: 0.95-1.05 pu from Dolatabadi et al. enhanced33 study convention; not a universal grid-code compliance assertion.
provenance.candidate_voltage: Research choice. 33 kV is used in distribution networks (NGED NDP); this is neither a published 33kV IEEE33 version nor a German/ACS network.
provenance.thermal_and_supply_limits: Explicit synthetic research assumptions, NOT IEEE33 source ratings, cable ampacity design, or a transformer specification. Sensitivity checks are mandatory.
provenance.electrical_modification: Keep physical R/X ohms, change actual nominal voltage to33kV. This reduces per-unit impedance and voltage drop; it is a changed synthetic network, not mere normalization or a proven upgrade design.

aidc.base_bus_reason: Near-feeder-head connection chosen as a transparent initial case; not selected by storage benefit or by tuning network limits.
aidc.connection_boundary: Direct equivalent load at existing bus; that bus is the PCC. No added dedicated connection line or site transformer. Their extra external impedance is not assessed.
aidc.model: Balanced three-phase constant PQ, quasi-steady-state AC power flow
aidc.loss_boundary: Frozen facility PCC P already includes facility UPS/site-transformer losses. Network branch losses are added only upstream. No double counting.
aidc.q_rule_future_storage: Q_PCC=P_facility_after_TES*tan(acos(pf))+Q_ESS; do not recompute Q from net P after ESS when Q_ESS=0.

screening.time_series_scope: Existing 1438 five-minute baseline PCC samples at bus2 with constant nominal background. No synchronized real background trace and no storage reoptimization.

not_claimed: One universal modified IEEE33 standard or full reproduction of the enhanced33 paper
Physical 33kV cable/transformer installation design, protection or short-circuit validation
Dynamic grid-code, frequency, harmonics, FRT, HIL or N-1 compliance
Network-derived multi-period DOE or DSO-AIDC coordination optimization
ESS-TES benefit, feasibility of previous exogenous25.5MW schedule, or robust guarantee under uncertainty
Final user approval of candidate numeric assumptions
